A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 35-page study, including Appendices A–D. Text comparison and rendering establish identical pages 2–35; differences are confined to first-page author-list and arXiv version/date information.

before.justification: Sections 5–7 report original experiments on prediction fidelity, rollout consistency, generalization and agent utility. Appendix C provides detailed out-of-distribution results.

after.justification: The same original experimental results are retained in Sections 5–7 and Appendix C.

M1.justification: The next-state modeling, fine-tuning, action verification, synthetic trajectory generation and reinforcement-learning warm-start procedures remain identical in Sections 3–4 and 7.

E1.justification: Both versions use ALFWorld, SciWorld, TextWorld, WebShop and StableToolBench, with identical task coverage and ALFWorld out-of-distribution scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout Tables 1–4 and 10, including the zero/few-shot model comparisons. Section 7 retains the same agent-training baselines.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix A retain identical data splits, sample counts, model configurations, training budgets, prediction metrics and rollout evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: The scaling, out-of-distribution, mixed-environment training and behavioral-coverage analyses in Section 6 are unchanged, as are the case studies in Appendix B.

E5.justification: Reporting of point estimates and averages over agents is identical. No run/seed information, uncertainty estimates or significance tests are added.

E6.justification: Numerical and qualitative results remain identical throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Qwen2.5-7B's ALFWorld next-state exact-match accuracy remains 99.87% in Table 1.

T1.justification: The agent/world-model mappings and trajectory definitions in Section 3.1, Equations 1–5, are identical. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same three-level evaluation framework and claims about fidelity, scaling, robustness and downstream agent utility.

C2.justification: Interpretations and qualifications concerning environment complexity, behavioral coverage, simulation drift and nonmonotonic verification benefits are unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendices A and D retain identical hyperparameters, hardware, checkpoints, training commands, initialization contexts and prompts. Code and data references, including their link destinations, are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the bibliography are identical. No cited works, novelty claims or relationships to prior research change.

P1.justification: v2 removes Mengdi Wang from the author list and updates the arXiv stamp from v1, 21 Dec 2025, to v2, 5 Mar 2026, including its link. All other wording and document structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: All figures and tables retain identical content, captions and placement. The author-list and stamp text edits leave the page layout unchanged.

improvement.justification: The revision changes only author-list and arXiv version/date information. The scientific arguments, experimental evidence, limitations, reproducibility details and substantive presentation, including all appendices, remain identical, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
